## Misses

**7. On average, what percentage of a cohort buys again in the month after their first purchase?**

```sql
SELECT retention_pct AS percentage FROM cohort_retention WHERE months_since_first = 1 LIMIT 1
```

**11. Which product (stock code) sold the most units?**

```sql
SELECT stock_code, description, units FROM top_products ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1
```

**16. Who are the 10 customers with the highest total spend?**

```sql
SELECT customer_id, monetary AS total_spend FROM rfm ORDER BY monetary DESC LIMIT 10
```

**22. What are the top 3 products by revenue in Germany?**

```sql
SELECT description, sum(revenue) as revenue FROM sales WHERE country = 'Germany' GROUP BY description ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3
```
